name: Band Leg Extension
steps: Anchor a resistance band low behind a sturdy chair, sit upright, and loop the free end around one ankle.
Plant your opposite foot flat on the floor and hold the sides of the chair to stabilize your hips.
Extend your banded knee smoothly until your leg is nearly straight, squeezing your quadriceps firmly at the top.
Lower your foot slowly back beneath your knee under tension, then switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Keep the back of your thigh pressed flat on the chair seat as your shin rises.
Control the return slowly rather than letting the band snap your foot backward.
